verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no CRM import or migration capability, and nothing about preserving records, owners, or activity history from another CRM. The nearest items are webhooks for moving real-time data, an OpenAPI spec, and an "add customers" onboarding line. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a migration feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate from another CRM with my records, owners, and history intact
